propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share identical 1,000,000 token context windows, making sonnet-to-opus escalation on context-limit error a guaranteed-failing paid call that gains zero capacity
Context-limit retry escalation silently fails to escalate when consecutive ladder rungs have equal windows, causing operators to misdiagnose as model inadequacy rather than exhausted escalation

A new escalation_rungs() function must filter models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, ensuring all proposed escalations represent real capacity increases
Both context-limit escalation loops (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to apply the filter
models_at_or_above, MODEL_LADDER contents, and largest_window_tokens must remain unchanged to preserve provider-stickiness semantics and model-class vocabulary resolution
